user.title: Connect to Quitoque
user.description:
The integration retrieves deliveries from the current week up to four weeks ahead (W0 to W+4). You can add recipes to your calendar and generate recipe PDFs. Weeks already present in the calendar are not imported again. PDFs are deleted according to your chosen retention period.

🔔 Optional notifications: receive an alert when a new order becomes editable and/or a reminder before recipe selection closes. Choose a reminder period of 1 to 7 days and a delivery method: Home Assistant notification, mobile push, or both. Select mobile devices below. Existing orders do not trigger new-order alerts on first startup.
